- "Add to all open rooms" (off by default)

# Bots get a `joined` webhook event whenever they're added to a room, by a person or automatically
# (see User#joins_all_open_rooms). Direct rooms never announce. Memberships are inserted in bulk

module Membership::BotGreeting

    # Inserts the memberships (hashes of room_id, user_id, …), skipping those that already exist.
